sentences.text: The applicant is an accused in the aforesaid case in which trial is going on which is at the stage of recording of the statement of the accused under Section 313 Cr.P.C.

An application dated 14.12.2022 was filed on behalf of the applicant that Smt. Arti- P.W.-5 be summoned under Section 311 Cr.P.C.
as the present lawyer has been appointed since the last 02 dates and the previous lawyer who had cross-examined her had not effectively cross-examined her.
The said application stood rejected vide order dated 14.12.2022 passed by the trial court.

Learned counsel for the applicant argued that since he does not challenge the order on merits but only on sympathetic consideration since the accused has a right of fair and an effective trial and the new lawyer engaged by him has after going through the statement of Smt. Arti- P.W.-5 comes to a conclusion that her effective cross-examination has not been done, one opportunity be given for her summoning and further cross-examination.
No other argument has been placed.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposed the present petition.

After hearing the learned counsel for the parties and perusing the records, it is evident that the trial is at the stage of recording of the statement of the accused under Section 313 Cr.P.C. Smt. Arti- P.W.-5 was examined on 06.06.2022 and was also cross-examined on the said date as is evident from the certified copy of her statement annexed as Annexure-3 to the affidavit.

The application dated 14.12.2022 filed under Section 311 Cr.P.C. is on the ground that a new lawyer has been engaged since the last 02 dates and he finds the said cross-examination as has been done to be not up to the required cross-examination as needed in the case and as such she be summoned for further cross-examination.
The said application stands rejected vide order dated 14.12.2022 which is impugned herein.
A perusal of the statement of Smt. Arti- P.W.-5 would go to show that she has been cross-examined by the defence lawyer.
The application dated 14.12.2022 filed under Section 311 Cr.P.C. does not state as to what is specifically needed for further cross-examination of the case.
The order impugned dated 14.12.2022 passed by the trial court is a detailed order on merits and on perusal of the same goes to show that it does not suffer from any irregularity or illegality.
Change of a lawyer only cannot be a ground for the trial court to exercise powers under Section 311 Cr.P.C.
There has to be much more shown from the records forexercising the said powers.

Merely by stating that the cross-examination as done by a previous lawyer was not effective and now the same has been seen by a newly engaged lawyer cannot be a ground for exercise of powers under Section 311 Cr.P.C.
The present petition is devoid of any merits and is accordingly rejected.

Order Date :- 20.1.2023 AS Rathore (Samit Gopal,J.)
